tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your friend, John, are planning a trip to Europe this summer. You have done some research and found some interesting destinations. Write an email to John.
bullets: Describe the destinations you have researched.
Explain why you think these destinations would be enjoyable.
Ask for his opinion on the suggested itinerary and any additional ideas he might have.
tasks.subject: Europe Trip Planning
